description: Casts a vote in another award for a user who already verified their email in this conversation (they have a voter_pass from awards_vote_confirm). One vote per award per email; a vote cannot be changed. Call only when the user asked to vote for this nominee.

nominee.description: The nominee: its slug from awards_search (for example "northwind-ai") or its website (for example northwind.ai).

voter_pass.description: The voter_pass returned by awards_vote_confirm (starts with "vp1."). Keep it only in this conversation.

name: awards_vote

message.description: One or two sentences to show the user as they are.

title: Vote with a voter pass
